name: core.openwop.workflows.insights-suite
description: Insights & Drafting meta-workflows as an RFC 0013 chain pack (migrated from the deprecated ADR 0082/0072 builtins, ADR 0472 Phase 2). Three real source→analysis→LLM→draft→notify pipelines over BYOK-connected sources. chainIds keep the original `openwop-app.insights.*` ids so scheduler/trigger ignition + replay are unchanged; the chains are also gallery-editable. 1.2.0 (ADR 0599 §5): each hard-required value is a chain PARAMETER bound as a WHOLE-VALUE `{{params.X}}` on a top-level node `inputs` entry, and data edges are port-qualified on BOTH sides. NOTIFY AUDIENCE (1.3.0 ADR 0600 §5; STATED in 1.3.1 §Correction 6): `self` resolves from the run's ACTING USER and refuses fail-closed without one, so a scheduled/webhook fire of `talent-prep` or `anniversary-draft` loses its completion notification — deliberate, since the alternative broadcasts a colleague's 9-box score or recognition draft workspace-wide. `weekly-variance` keeps `tenant`: no declared PII, and its only lane is the scheduler.

chains.label: Weekly variance (Actual vs Plan)
chains.description: Pull financials → compute variance → human red-team → notify. (1.1.0: the input-less render step was removed — WF-DOC-3. 1.2.0: `sql` is a declared parameter bound into the query node — ADR 0599 §5; the query→compute edge is port-qualified so the variance node receives `rows`, not the BigQuery envelope.)

projectId.description: BigQuery project for the financials read. Tenant-specific — no default is possible; the scheduled lane supplies it from the suite config's `planSource.projectId`.

businessUnit.description: Business unit to analyze. Labels the variance result.

sql.description: The financials read. It MUST return one row per metric with `metric` / `actual` / `plan` columns — that is the contract `variance-compute` consumes, and a result set without them makes the node fail `insufficient_data` rather than report a verdict. Edit this to match your warehouse.
sql.default: SELECT metric, actual, plan FROM `finance.weekly_variance` WHERE period = 'current_week'

config.title: Variance red-team
config.prompt: Confirm the variance figures before surfacing.

chains.label: Work-anniversary recognition draft
chains.description: Pull milestones → retrieve voice exemplars → LLM drafts → email DRAFT (never sends) → approval → notify. (1.1.0 — ADR 0599 §5: `workdayBaseUrl`, `exemplarQuery`, `recipient` and `draftSubject` are declared parameters bound into the nodes that hard-require them; the generate→emailDraft edge is port-qualified `content`→`body`, because the LLM emits `content` and the draft node reads `body` — supplying only the recipient would have created an EMPTY draft and reported it a success.) 1.2.0 — ADR 0600 §5: notifies at `audience:"self"` rather than telling the whole workspace a recognition draft was made about a named colleague and linking them to it.

workdayResource.description: Workday resource the trigger reads — defaults to serviceDates; override for other milestone types.

workdayBaseUrl.description: Your Workday tenant REST base, e.g. `https://{instance}.workday.com/ccx/api/v1/{tenant}`. Tenant-specific and required — ADR 0082 named the connection `instanceUrlTemplate` as the source, and that field is read nowhere in the repo (ADR 0599 §5 retires the claim).

exemplarQuery.description: What to retrieve from the knowledge base as voice exemplars.
exemplarQuery.default: work anniversary recognition message exemplars in the principal's voice

recipient.description: The mailbox the recognition message is addressed TO. The draft is created in YOUR mailbox and is never sent — nothing leaves until a human sends it by hand.

config.systemPrompt: Draft a warm, specific work-anniversary recognition message in the principal’s voice, grounded in the retrieved exemplars and the milestone. Plain text, no salutation block.

config.title: Approve draft
config.prompt: Review the recognition draft. It is a DRAFT only — nothing is sent.

chains.label: Talent readiness prep
chains.description: Pull performance data → 9-box readiness score → notify. (1.1.0 — ADR 0599 §5: `workdayBaseUrl` is a declared parameter bound into the pull node, and the pull→score edge is port-qualified so the score node receives the review `rows` it derives ratings from rather than the Workday envelope. 1.2.0 — ADR 0600 §5: notifies at `audience:"self"` rather than broadcasting a link to a named person's 9-box score workspace-wide, and the score→notify edge is port-qualified `score.label → notify.message` so the notification body is no longer empty — the two are one decision, since a body is only safe once the audience is one person.)

subjectId.description: The person to score. Required — the score node refuses without it.

workdayBaseUrl.description: Your Workday tenant REST base, e.g. `https://{instance}.workday.com/ccx/api/v1/{tenant}`.
